title: The Shepherd Looks for Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The sheep were scattered far and wide
One dark and cloudy day;
No one went out to look for them,
They wandered from the way.

[Chorus]
"I'll look for all My sheep Myself,
I'll find them where they roam;
I'll bring them back to good green grass,
I'll carry each one home."

[Verse 2]
The Lord said to Ezekiel,
"My sheep are all alone;
I'll go Myself and search for them
And call them each My own."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He wraps the hurt ones up with care,
A bandage on a knee;
He makes the weak ones strong again,
He does the same for me.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
He knows my name and where I am,
He finds me every day;
I'll find the friend who sits alone
And ask them, "Come and play!"

[Chorus]
mood: Searching music that turns into finding. A soft, patient walking step under the voice, like a shepherd moving through tall grass, stopping to listen, then moving on. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the step, one low warm note held underneath each time a lost one is found. The verses stay gentle and the chorus opens a little more each time it comes round, and the last verse is bright and sunny, a child crossing a playground to sit beside a friend.
